cd /tmp && SYNECDOCHE_SITE=/workspace/site LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native timeout 170 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, os, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib, json, shutil, time
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
proj = pathlib.Path(tmp)/'project'
proj.mkdir()
for f in pathlib.Path('/workspace/submission').rglob('*'):
    if f.is_file():
        dest = proj/f.relative_to('/workspace/submission')
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy(f, dest)
code = r'''
import sys, os, io, types
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace')
from public_child import restrict
restrict()
filename = sys.argv[1]; scratch = sys.argv[2]
os.chdir(scratch)
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(filename))
sys.path.insert(0, os.environ['SYNECDOCHE_SITE'])
module = types.ModuleType('__main__')
module.__file__ = filename; module.__package__ = None; module.__spec__ = None
sys.modules['__main__'] = module
sys.argv = [filename]
source = open(filename, 'rb').read()
exec(compile(source, filename, 'exec'), module.__dict__)
'''
env = dict(os.environ, SYNECDOCHE_SITE='/workspace/site', LD_LIBRARY_PATH='/workspace/native',
           HOME=tmp, TMPDIR=tmp, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', PYTHONUNBUFFERED='1',
           PYTHONHASHSEED='0', OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1', OMP_NUM_THREADS='1', MKL_NUM_THREADS='1')
start = time.time()
with open('/tmp/big.json','rb') as fh:
    payload = fh.read()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-c', code, str(proj/'run.py'), tmp],
                   input=payload, capture_output=True, env=env, cwd=tmp, timeout=160)
print('rc', p.returncode, 'wall %.1fs' % (time.time()-start), 'out %d bytes' % len(p.stdout))
print('stderr:', p.stderr.decode()[:300])
d = json.loads(p.stdout)
print('decisions', len(d['decisions']), 'final', d['final'])
shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
PYEOF
